title: EVERY BUSH AND TREE STANDS ON A PATCH OF GRASS
why: His note on the v34.78 photo: bricks on the floor but a bush on top of the bricks makes no sense. The road cull only knows roads, so bushes still sat on slabs and tarmac. The ground bake now paints a ragged turf patch under every bush and tree. Render layer only: bushes and trees do not move and no seeded draw changes.
now: Bushes and trees sit on a patch of grass instead of on bare slab.
